# A game's own hooks. Two violations and four near-misses.
#
# Naming a singleton here is banned for a mechanical reason, not a stylistic one: both the
# per-file parse gate and tools/compile_all.gd SKIP any script that names one, so this file
# would stop being compiled by anything and could only fail in front of a player.
extends GameHooks


func on_interact(ctx: GameContext, target: Interactor.Target) -> bool:
	# VIOLATION 1 - the singleton, read directly.
	if GameState.has_flag(&"has_gate_key"):
		return false
	# VIOLATION 2 - a different singleton, still a singleton.
	Router.open_overlay(0)

	# Near miss: a local whose name merely resembles one.
	var game_state := ctx.has_flag(&"has_gate_key")
	# Near miss: the name inside a string, which is text and not a call.
	var note := "GameState.has_flag is what this used to do"
	# Near miss: GameState. and Router. appear in this comment and must stay quiet.
	# Near miss: the sanctioned way to ask for the same thing.
	ctx.set_flag(&"looked_at_thing")
	return game_state and note.is_empty() and target != null
